messages:
Maya (PM): morning async — quick canary check-in for the feature-flag slice.
Maya (PM): what I did: kicked off 5% canary for slice-A at 02:10 UTC, validated routing, ran smoke evals against top-10 prompts.
Maya (PM): blockers: still seeing intermittent 95th p latency spikes on the tiled-large model, not sure if it's batching or kernel choice.
Chris (Eng): looked through scheduler logs — saw a couple of 1.2s stalls at 02:17 that line up with a GC from a sidecar process. I pushed a small retry-window increase in the canary policy.
Chris (Eng): also updated the feature flag to fall back to model-v1.3 if tail latency > 900ms for 2 consecutive minutes.
Sam (SRE): deploy-bot shows 2 infra alerts during the window, both resolved: node-az3 transient OOM evicted a worker, autoscaler rebalanced.
Sam (SRE): I added a temporary pin to avoid placement on az3 for the next hour; can revert once we confirm stability.
Ellie (Docs): thanks — I'll update the runbook note about the az3 mitigation and the new retry-window change.
Maya (PM): can @Chris drop the exact scheduler log snippet and the flag patch so I can annotate the rollout doc?
Chris (Eng): sure, snippet below:
```
2026-03-17T02:17:23Z scheduler.go:487 WARNING: batch stall detected, worker=worker-17, stall_ms=1213
2026-03-17T02:17:24Z sidecar.go:102 INFO: GC pause 1.1s
```
Chris (Eng): feature flag diff: ffctl update canary_slice_a --fallback model-v1.3 --tail-latency-threshold 900 --window 120
Maya (PM): nice. next actions: 1) monitor p50/p95 for 30 more mins, 2) if no regressions bump to 10% at 03:00 UTC, 3) roll docs and incident note if we keep the az3 pin.
Sam (SRE): monitoring in place, alerting threshold lowered to catch >800ms anomalies.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] canary/slice-A started at 02:10 UTC — rollout=5% — id=canary-20260317-01 :rocket:
Ellie (Docs): one small doc question — should we mention the retry-window increase in the public rollout notes? recommend yes for transparency.
Maya (PM): agreed, include a short line about graceful retry change and reason (mitigates transient stalls).
Chris (Eng): ping me if you see >3 regressions in the next 15m, I'll revert the flag immediately.
Maya (PM): thanks team — I'll post a status update in #product after the 03:00 bump. :thumbsup:
